text: In nineteen sixty-nine, one man was more alone than anyone had ever been.
While Neil and Buzz walked on the Moon, Michael Collins circled it by himself.
Every time he passed behind the Moon, the radio went silent for about forty-five minutes.
They called him the loneliest man in history.
But he said he wasn't lonely. He felt part of everything happening below.
Knowing someone is out there changes everything.
That's why we made Feeloy. Jenny is always there for you.
